entry.title: Landau–Siegel zeros and a Stepanov-type nonvanishing lemma, v4
entry.summary: Shortens the abstract, the comparison with other proofs and the authorship statement, and makes one statement in §1 exact. The mathematics is unchanged.

entry.title: Landau–Siegel zeros and a Stepanov-type nonvanishing lemma, v3
entry.summary: Corrects attributions and dates. The growing weight is credited to version 1, Green's version 2 is dated 18 October, van Dijk's two versions are described separately, and each cited preprint names its version. The mathematics is unchanged.

entry.title: Landau–Siegel zeros and a Stepanov-type nonvanishing lemma, v2
entry.summary: Following Barreto, a rectangular box of points lowers the coefficient of log q from ½ to ¼ and gives (1−β) log q ≥ 1 − O(log log q / log q). The Stepanov nonvanishing argument is kept. The exposition is rewritten, the comparison with other proofs now includes van Dijk's, and references are added.
